allow: Bash(python -c "import sys; lines=sys.stdin.readlines\(\); [print\(l, end=''\) for l in lines]")

Bash(python -c " import sys, re taker_fires = 0 spreads = [] for line in sys.stdin: if 'TAKER' in line: taker_fires += 1 m = re.search\(r'SPREAD:\(\\d+\)', line\) if m: spreads.append\(int\(m.group\(1\)\)\) print\('taker fires:', taker_fires\) if spreads: import statistics print\(f'spread: mean={statistics.mean\(spreads\):.1f} min={min\(spreads\)} max={max\(spreads\)}'\) ")

Bash(python -c " import sys, statistics spreads, trends, combineds = [], [], [] for line in sys.stdin: parts = line.strip\(\).split\(\) for p in parts: if p.startswith\('spread='\): spreads.append\(int\(p.split\('='\)[1]\)\) elif p.startswith\('trend='\): trends.append\(float\(p.split\('='\)[1]\)\) elif p.startswith\('combined='\): combineds.append\(float\(p.split\('='\)[1]\)\) print\(f'n={len\(spreads\)}'\) print\(f'spread: mean={statistics.mean\(spreads\):.1f} min={min\(spreads\)} max={max\(spreads\)} p50={sorted\(spreads\)[len\(spreads\)//2]}'\) sp = sorted\(spreads\) for thresh in [2,3,4,5,6,8,10]: pct = sum\(1 for s in spreads if s <= thresh\) / len\(spreads\) * 100 print\(f' spread <= {thresh}: {pct:.1f}%'\) print\(f'trend_signal: mean={statistics.mean\(trends\):.2f} max={max\(trends\):.2f} min={min\(trends\):.2f}'\) for thresh in [0.3, 0.4, 0.5, 0.6]: pct = sum\(1 for t in trends if abs\(t\) >= thresh\) / len\(trends\) * 100 print\(f' |trend| >= {thresh}: {pct:.1f}%'\) print\(f'combined: mean={statistics.mean\(combineds\):.2f} max={max\(combineds\):.2f} min={min\(combineds\):.2f}'\) ")
